name: Desco Infratech Ltd
title: Desco Infratech Ltd - 544387 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Small CGD EPC player with H2 revenue up ~99% to INR 118.8 cr, but margins squeezed by new power/solar EPC, operating cash flow still negative (~INR 18-19 cr) and unsecured NBFC debt at 16-17%; FY27 growth targets are unsupported by any capacity or order data.

capex.quote: we are even expanding our plant to set up another 15 to 20 tons per day capacity by a period of next 18 months

triggers.label: Operating cash flow negative INR 18-19 cr
triggers.quote: our operation negative cash flow is I think INR 18 crores to INR 19 crores

triggers.label: Margin squeezed by power/solar EPC mix
triggers.quote: The margins got a little bit squeezed due to our entry in power distribution and solar EPC solution projects

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 70-80% YoY
triggers.quote: I can see the revenue growth by I think minimum 70% to 80% year-on-year

triggers.label: Order book INR 345 cr, 330-332 cr CGD
triggers.quote: out of INR 345 crores, INR 330 crores – INR 332 crores remains with the city gas distribution sector

triggers.label: Bidding aggression lowering margins
triggers.quote: people are doing more aggressive bidding, then we will not get or we will have to match with competitive intensity

guidance.quote: I can see the revenue growth by I think minimum 70% to 80% year-on-year
what I foresee is INR 1,000 crores we will be able to achieve easily by 2030
the debt-to-equity ratio may go maximum at 0.3 in coming 1.5 years or something
in coming next 2 years, we will be reporting the cash flow operating that will be positive
we are even expanding our plant to set up another 15 to 20 tons per day capacity by a period of next 18 months

prior_guidance_check.quote: our operation negative cash flow is I think INR 18 crores to INR 19 crores
It remains the consistent with 15.3% profit after tax

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow despite profit growth
red_flags.quote: the cash flow is still negative

red_flags.label: Unsecured NBFC debt at 16-17%
red_flags.quote: considering every NBFCs at the rate of around 16% to 17% per annum for now

red_flags.label: Unbilled/WIP inflating other current assets
red_flags.quote: other current assets are they are basically work in progress

red_flags.label: Evasive answer on margin decline and promoter motive
red_flags.quote: no one wants to show profits to pay taxes to the government

red_flags.label: Unbilled and retention receivables stretching cycle
red_flags.quote: there is an involvement of retention amount in debtors

evasions.quote: Yes, so like it's a good question Aniket, thank you for this question. Yes, the margins are sustainable at this current level.
Sir, it will become positive the reason is that we are in a listed space now.

evasions.topic: Why profits not shown to taxes
evasions.quote: no one wants to show profits to pay taxes to the government
